payload.claim: The Out-of-scope section's 'Hand edits' instructs adding one sentence to DESIGN.md's §6.1 paragraph and one sentence to CONTEXT.md's Re-gate entry, both citing SA-0404, as if they do not yet exist. Both sentences already exist verbatim at this snapshot (DESIGN.md line 1475 and CONTEXT.md lines 552-553), apparently added when SA-0403 landed. Since both files are forbidden to the cell this does not affect the build, but an operator following the instruction literally could duplicate text that is already present; this should be confirmed by a person before treating the hand-edit step as still outstanding.
